gaps.sentence: We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.

gaps.sentence: Our street was cut ___ for three hours after the storm.
gaps.explanation: cut off = disconnected (power, phone); isolate (a village cut off by snow).

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: You should cut down ___ sugar if you want to lose weight.
gaps.explanation: cut down ON something = reduce it; cut out = eliminate completely.

gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
